sentences.en: The calorie is an exact measure of the energy in food.
sentences.zh: 卡路里是衡量食物能量的精确单位。

sentences.en: Which foods are rich in calories and which aren't?
sentences.zh: 哪些食物富含卡路里，哪些又不富含？

sentences.en: Adopting a low calorie diet will increase your lifespan.
sentences.zh: 采用低热量饮食可以延长寿命。

senses.zh: 卡（路里）（热量单位）；小卡（现一般定为4.1868焦耳）；大卡，千卡
